content.text: The document expressly negates exclusivity. No redline needed.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Services clause (Section 1) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms that AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell it to third parties, so AP's freedom to use other vendors is fully preserved. The only other "exclusive" references are the non-exclusive license grant to us (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction (p0064), each party's own trademark ownership (p0065) and no-third-party-beneficiary language (p0073) — none imposes a sole-supplier or requirements obligation on AP. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer); no redline required.
